info.title: 101 Codecrafts API
info.description: Versioned REST API (/api/v1). Every response is `{ data }` or `{ error }`. Auth = Clerk session (cookie or Bearer). Generated by backend/scripts/gen-openapi.mjs.

put.summary: Set / extend the launch promo (ends_at defaults to starts_at + 1 month). Audited via site_settings trigger.

post.summary: Approve → immediately initiate the Flutterwave transfer (MTN/Airtel MoMo or bank).

get.summary: Public catalogue of free AI tools (approved only). We never store users' personal API keys.

post.summary: Public catalogue of free AI tools (approved only). We never store users' personal API keys.
Free on-site AI chat for members (quota by plan, moderated, server-side keys only).
Practice AI helper. Never reveals a full solution while the problem is in an upcoming/live contest.

post.summary: Pre-check before sign-up / email change / invite (rate-limited per IP). Clerk restrictions + webhook enforce it too.

get.summary: Daily: opportunity expiry + 7d/1d deadline reminders, meeting 24h reminders. (15-min reminders need a sub-daily scheduler: Supabase pg_cron or GitHub Actions.)
Auto-releases escrow 7 days after delivery when there is no open dispute.
Re-judges stuck submissions and runs plagiarism checks on contests that ended in the last 24h.
